description:
A thousand years ago, a war broke out between humans and gods, led by the "Su-Myeong-Jang-Ja." In this war, the only god who fought on the side of humans was Ogu. Defeated by the gods, Su-Myeong-Jang-Ja was split into ten thousand insects and scattered across the world, and Ogu-Shin was punished by being trapped in the cycle of reincarnation. A thousand years later, Ogu-Shin was reincarnated into the body of a young girl, Ba-Ri, and Su-Myeong-Jang-Ja also showed signs of resurrection. This horrific war must never happen again! Ba-Ri and Ogu embark on a journey to stop Su-Myeong-Jang-Ja's plans and find the God of Heaven and Earth... 

Will Ba-Ri be able to save humanity and prove her own existence on this journey?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
